literal_meaning: A bump or knock (typically on the head)
figurative_meaning_en: A sound or memorable lesson (often through punishment)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওকে একটা ঠোক্কর দাও, যাতে সে আর কখনো ভুল না করে।
জীবনের এই ঠোক্কর থেকে অনেক কিছু শিখলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: Give him a good bump so he never makes the mistake again.
I learned a lot from this bump in life's road.
note: The idiom evokes physical correction as a metaphor for lasting impact, common in rural Bengali speech.
